name: Shared-Memory Parallel Raycasting (CPU)
definition: A raycasting volume renderer parallelized using a shared-memory programming model where each thread casts rays into the volume, performs color and opacity integration, and writes to a final image buffer.
summary: Shared-Memory Parallel Raycasting on CPUs distributes volume rendering across multiple threads using explicit thread management and dynamic work queues to handle load imbalance, distinguishing it from GPU-based SIMT execution.
